eps.jobs.review_jobs_user_insert.with_check:
((kind = ANY (ARRAY['ai_suggestion'::text, 'review_fit'::text])) AND (requested_by = auth.uid()) AND (status = 'queued'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_suggestion'::text, 'measure_review_fit'::text])) AND (attempt = 0) AND (dispatch_generation = 1) AND (current_attempt_id IS NULL) AND (lease_token_digest IS NULL) AND eps.review_scope(workspace_id) AND eps.project_scope(( SELECT workspaces.project_id
   FROM eps.workspaces
  WHERE (workspaces.id = jobs.workspace_id)), true) AND eps.has_capability('cast.read'::text) AND (((kind = 'ai_suggestion'::text) AND eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text)) OR ((kind = 'review_fit'::text) AND eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text))))

eps.media_assets.review_assets_read.qual:
(((purpose = 'client_logo'::text) AND (((origin_workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND eps.review_scope(origin_workspace_id)) OR ((client_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM public.clients c
  WHERE (c.id = media_assets.client_id)))))) OR (eps.has_capability('cast.read'::text) AND ((purpose = ANY (ARRAY['candidate_video'::text, 'candidate_frame'::text])) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.candidate_media m
  WHERE (m.source_asset_id = media_assets.id))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.candidate_media_frames f
  WHERE (f.asset_id = media_assets.id)))))))

   FROM eps.jobs j
  WHERE (j.id = job_events.job_id)))
eps.job_events.review_events_service.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs j
  WHERE (j.id = job_events.job_id)))

eps.workspaces.review_workspace_lock.qual: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, true) AND (eps.has_capability('presentations.generate'::text) OR eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text)))

eps.workspaces.review_workspace_read.qual: ((archived_at IS NULL) AND eps.project_scope(project_id, false) AND (eps.has_capability('workspaces.read'::text) OR eps.has_capability('presentations.generate'::text)))

   FROM eps.jobs j

eps.outbox_events.review_outbox_user_ins.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM eps.jobs j
  WHERE ((j.id = outbox_events.job_id) AND (j.kind = ANY (ARRAY['ai_suggestion'::text, 'review_fit'::text])) AND (j.requested_by = auth.uid()) AND (j.status = 'queued'::text))))

eps.ai_suggestions.review_suggestions_in.with_check:
(eps.review_scope(workspace_id) AND eps.project_scope(( SELECT workspaces.project_id
   FROM eps.workspaces
  WHERE (workspaces.id = ai_suggestions.workspace_id)), true) AND eps.has_capability('workspaces.write'::text) AND eps.has_capability('cast.read'::text))

created.eps.review_fit_results.review_fit_result: CHECK ((((status = 'measured'::text) AND (result IS NOT NULL) AND (error_code IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'failed'::text) AND (result IS NULL) AND (error_code IS NOT NULL))))

eps.jobs.jobs_kind_stage_check.before: CHECK ((((kind = 'specs_extract'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_document'::text, 'extract_specs'::text, 'apply_specs'::text]))) OR ((kind = 'candidate_scan'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_candidate'::text, 'transcribe_candidate'::text, 'extract_candidate'::text, 'select_frames'::text, 'apply_candidate'::text]))) OR ((kind = 'frame_extract'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['extract_frames'::text, 'apply_frames'::text])))))
eps.jobs.jobs_kind_stage_check.expected: CHECK ((((kind = 'specs_extract'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_document'::text, 'extract_specs'::text, 'apply_specs'::text]))) OR ((kind = 'candidate_scan'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_candidate'::text, 'transcribe_candidate'::text, 'extract_candidate'::text, 'select_frames'::text, 'apply_candidate'::text]))) OR ((kind = 'frame_extract'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['extract_frames'::text, 'apply_frames'::text]))) OR ((kind = 'ai_suggestion'::text) AND (stage = ANY (ARRAY['prepare_suggestion'::text, 'generate_suggestion'::text, 'validate_suggestion'::text]))) OR ((kind = 'review_fit'::text) AND (stage = 'measure_review_fit'::text))))
